svg.title: VIPMP Volume Level Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-vipmp-volume-level-ladder; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: VIPMP Volume Level Ladder; subtitle: Four per-end-customer price levels on Adobe VIP Marketplace; total range: 1 to 100+ units per end customer; caption: VIP Marketplace keys price to per-customer seat counts, with auto-renewal on the anniversary date and a 14-day return window.; assumptions note: Level 1 starts at a single unit; Level 4 is open-ended above 100 units. Levels 3 and 4 currently carry the same discount.; note: Attributed to David Villanueva of TD SYNNEX Spain.; buckets: label: Level 1; low: 1; high: 9; notes: Up to 9 units; move single-unit customers to auto-renewal; label: Level 2; low: 10; high: 49; notes: First price break; label: Level 3; low: 50; high: 99; notes: Same discount as Level 4 today; label: Level 4; low: 100; high: 100; notes: 100 units and above
